audience: Zed is for people who want a fast editor and multiplayer without paying, and who will bring their own keys. The verdict says the editor itself is free forever, and Pro at $10 only includes $5 of hosted tokens before usage billing. If the editor is the product you wanted, Personal at $0 is the plan.

Pro is for people who want Zed's hosted tokens and accept that $5 is a small pool. Business is for a team that will pay $30 a seat with no bundled token credit at all. If you wanted an included agent allowance the size of the seat, this is the wrong shape.
features: Personal is $0. The pros say the fast editor and multiplayer are free, and you can bring your own API keys on the free plan. That is a complete editor, not a trial that locks the file tree.

Pro is $10 a month and includes $5 of hosted tokens, then API list plus 10%. The 14-day Pro trial does not need a card. Business is $30 per seat a month and includes no bundled token credit. Hosted usage on Pro is the list price plus 10%, which is a markup, not a subsidy.

The trial is the right way to see the hosted side. Fourteen days, no card, then you are back on Personal unless you want the $5 pool. Do not start the trial if a card-on-file later would bother you. This one does not ask for the card up front.
limitations: Pro's included tokens are only $5. The seat is $10. You pay $10 to receive $5 of hosted tokens, and then you pay API list plus 10%. The verdict is written that way so nobody mistakes Pro for a discounted API plan.
Business does not fix it with a bigger bundle. It has no bundled token credit at $30 a seat. A team on Business is paying for the seat and then paying for tokens in full.

The rating is Depends. The editor is the easy yes at $0. The hosted tokens are the part that depends on whether a $5 pool and a 10% markup are acceptable. Bring your own key on Personal if they are not.
pricingNotes: From zed.dev/pricing, checked 14 October 2026. Personal is $0. Pro is $10 a month, with $5 of hosted tokens, then API list plus 10%. Business is $30 per seat a month, with no bundled token credit.
The Pro trial is 14 days and does not require a card. No annual price is in the table, so none is printed. The 10% figure is the markup after the included $5, not a discount.
